title: ProtocolRevision
description: An MCP protocol revision sk-mcp advertises. Both SDKs speak exactly this set: the .NET SDK (ModelContextProtocol 2.2.0) ships no earlier revision, so a revision listed here that it cannot negotiate would be a claim neither side can honour. The enum is ordered oldest first; `default` names the revision an sk-mcp server advertises when the caller states no preference.
